line: One tax year's receipts and statements gathered in one place, each with the file it came from.

name: teams
line: Microsoft Teams chats from your Microsoft account's export, one dated line per message.

name: telegram-bot
line: Ask from your phone through a Telegram bot only you can talk to.
network: api.telegram.org, to receive your questions and send answers

name: texts
line: Phone text messages, from an Android SMS backup or an iPhone backup's copy, one dated line per message.

name: thesis
line: A thesis's claims, each tied to the source that backs it, and a list of the ones with none.

name: tic-tac-toe
line: Tic-tac-toe as rows: every move, and the solver's value of each position; perfect play draws.

name: tides
line: Tide predictions as a control: if your Brier score on tides isn't near zero, the forecasting plumbing is broken.
network: NOAA's tides API, to read predictions and what happened

name: time-capsule
line: A note sealed now and opened on a date you choose, with the record proving it wasn't changed.

name: todays-place
line: One place a day drawn from Natural Earth's public-domain list, for the day's questions and bets.

name: translate
line: An answer translated by a local model, the original kept beside it, the translation held until you seal it.
needs: a local model server; licence varies by model

name: trello
line: A Trello board's JSON export: cards, checklists and comments, by list.

name: trips
line: Your trips from booking emails and tickets: where you went, when, and where you stayed.

name: tui
line: A full-screen terminal view to ask, read passages and approve, in curses.

name: upgrade-notes
line: Before an upgrade: the changelog lines between the version you lock and the one you'd move to, from the package's own files.
network: the registry (PyPI, npm or crates.io), to fetch the newer version's changelog

name: upstream-desk
line: Your work in other people's projects, in one place: notifications sorted into what needs you, and your open pull requests there.
network: GitHub, through gh, with your own login

name: vectors
line: The meaning add-on's vectors kept in the store's own SQLite file, so they're computed once per passage, not at every question.
needs: sqlite-vec and model2vec; MIT or Apache-2.0

name: vocab
line: The words you're learning, from your notes and the texts you read, with where you met each one.

name: voice
line: Dictation, calls and lectures transcribed into dated text.

name: warm
line: The kernel kept running between questions on this machine, so each question skips the start-up.

name: watch
line: A file re-read the moment it changes (inotify, FSEvents, or polling), so the index is always current.

name: weather-bet
line: Wager on rain tomorrow before you look, against Open-Meteo's own forecast, and see whose Brier score wins.
network: api.open-meteo.com, to read the forecast and the outcome

name: welcome
line: One plain thank-you on a first-time contributor's first pull request, once per person, and only where it's turned on.
network: the forge, through the workflow's token, to post the thank-you

name: witness
line: A second person's seal beside yours, for answers that need two people to agree.

name: words-hi
line: Hindi common words ('और', 'है').

name: words-ja
line: Japanese, which has no spaces: a small segmenter of its own and a common-words list.

name: words-zh
line: Chinese, which has no spaces: words found by a small segmenter of its own, and a common-words list.

name: writefreely
line: WriteFreely posts, from its export or a copy of its SQLite database, as dated text.

name: zotero
line: Your Zotero library, from a copy of zotero.sqlite: items, notes and PDF annotations, each with its citation.
